content.short: Discover Infinex, a highly optimized DeFi Dapps protocol focusing on decentralized exchanges to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Infinex is a decentralized exchange by Synthetix. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Infinex redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Base and Polygon and Ethereum and Solana to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Infinex stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
content.meta: Infinex provides innovative decentralized exchanges tools for the DeFi Dapps space. Discover Infinex and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
